_comment: Device limits. See internal/design/device_limits_research.md for sources and confidence. Refine via community feedback.

_units.max_speed: position-units per second (0-100 range, so 400 = full stroke 4x/sec)
_units.max_bpm: beats per minute — max comfortable cycling rate
_units.min_cycle_ms: minimum time for one full up-down cycle in milliseconds
_units.max_acceleration: max position-units per second squared (how fast speed can change)
_units.max_delta: max position change between consecutive actions (0-100). Estim comfort limit.

handy.name: The Handy
handy.notes: Confidence: MEDIUM. 400 pos/s is community consensus. Marketing says '10 strokes/s' but practical max is ~400mm/s at typical stroke lengths. No official vendor spec published. Verify at handyfeeling.com/docs. No Handy v2 exists as of 2026-04-12.

osr2.name: OSR2
osr2.notes: Confidence: LOW. Speed depends on servo model and build quality (300-600 mm/s range). 500 is mid-range for standard 20kg.cm servos. OSR Wiki and vendor pages don't publish speed specs. Stroke: 112mm default / 150mm max.

estim_foc.name: Estim — FOC
estim_foc.notes: Single-channel estim. Speed backstop at 600 pos/s (curated scripts run 700+). Primary protection is Groove (humanize) not speed clamp. restim firmware adds internal ramping.

generic.name: Generic / Intiface
generic.notes: Confidence: LOW. Conservative fallback for Lovense/Kiiroo/WeVibe Bluetooth devices. Each device has different limits; 300 is a safe floor. Intiface (Buttplug.io) is a protocol, not a device.

estim_stereo.name: Estim — Stereo
estim_stereo.notes: Dual-channel estim. Same limits as FOC. Primary protection is Groove (humanize). Volume channel differs from FOC for L/R balance.

legacy.name: Audio 3-phase — continuous
legacy.notes: Confidence: LOW. Audio-driven continuous waveform. 'Velocity' here is envelope-change rate, not mechanical speed. 500 pos/s is a perceptual ceiling estimate — hardware can go faster but sensation plateaus.

stereostim.name: Audio 3-phase — pulse (Stereostim)
stereostim.notes: Confidence: LOW-MEDIUM. Pulse-based estim allows faster parameter changes than continuous. 600 pos/s perceptual ceiling. Replaces old estim_stereo key.

foc3phase.name: FOC-Stim — 3-phase
foc3phase.notes: Confidence: LOW-MEDIUM. Direct current control via ESP32+DRV8231A, no audio bottleneck. Hardware can exceed 700 pos/s; 700 is a perceptual ceiling. FOC-Stim v4 specs: 30V drive, <5uC charge, 3-5kHz operational range. Source: github.com/diglet48/FOC-Stim

foc4phase.name: FOC-Stim — 4-phase
foc4phase.notes: Confidence: LOW. Experimental FOC 4-phase mode. Same hardware as foc3phase; limits assumed identical pending vendor data.

neostim.name: NeoStim — 3-phase
neostim.notes: Confidence: VERY LOW. No documentation found (web search returned medical devices). 550 is interpolated between stereostim and FOC. Update immediately when a NeoStim user reports real-world limits.
